#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>

using namespace std;

bool isWordChar(char c) {
    return (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') || (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') || (c >= '0' && c <= '9') || c == '_';
}

long long countInside(const string& inner) {
    long long count = 0;
    stringstream ss(inner);
    string part;
    while (getline(ss, part, '_')) {
        if (!part.empty()) {
            count++;
        }
    }
    return count;
}

int main() {
    int n;
    string s;
    cin >> n >> s;
    
    int longest = 0;
    long long inside = 0;
    int wordLen = 0;
    int i = 0;
    int len = s.length();
    
    while (i < len) {
        char c = s[i];
        if (c == '(') {
            int j = i + 1;
            while (j < len && isWordChar(s[j])) {
                j++;
            }
            if (j < len && s[j] == ')') {
                if (wordLen > longest) {
                    longest = wordLen;
                }
                wordLen = 0;
                inside += countInside(s.substr(i + 1, j - i - 1));
                i = j + 1;
                continue;
            }
        }
        if (c == '_') {
            if (wordLen > longest) {
                longest = wordLen;
            }
            wordLen = 0;
        } else {
            wordLen++;
        }
        i++;
    }
    if (wordLen > longest) {
        longest = wordLen;
    }
    
    cout << longest << " " << inside << endl;
    return 0;
}
